snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Lex Imperialis Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
"Lex Imperialis" - the second story expansion for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - is to be released on June 24, 2025. It features15 hours of compelling gameplay, a new companion, Familiars, and an entirely new faction: the Adeptus Arbites.
